patch_resolves_note: The fixed OVS patch removes UFID acceptance from parse_odp_key_mask_attr(), so the original PoC is guarded before nl_attr_get_size(mask). The adjacent genuine witness case set(skb_priority(0)) shows that when the fixed set-action path does execute the size calculation, maskbuf.size is already at least NLA_HDRLEN.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: After parse_odp_key_mask_attr() returns in the set(...) branch, the caller must not proceed to nl_attr_get_size(mask) unless maskbuf.size already covers one initialized nlattr header (maskbuf.size >= NLA_HDRLEN).
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed parser no longer treats ufid: as a successful generic key/mask parse in this caller context, so the original witness is rejected before the size read and a valid set(...) witness reaches the size call only with a materialized mask header.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the vulnerable original case, set_post_parse records maskbuf_size=0 and the protected mask_size_call executes. In the fixed original case, set_post_parse records retval=-22 with no protected event (guarded). The adjacent witness valid_set_skb_priority executes mask_size_call on the fixed side with maskbuf_size=8 >= NLA_HDRLEN=4.

nodes.description: At the source-level sink nl_attr_get_size(mask), the staged witness reaches the call with maskbuf.size still 0 even though a valid nlattr header requires NLA_HDRLEN bytes, so the call reads from stack storage whose header was never materialized.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records mask_size_call.nla_hdrlen=4 > mask_size_call.maskbuf_size=0.

edges.description: The same empty maskbuf.size state returned to parse_odp_action after parse_odp_key_mask_attr() is carried unchanged to the later nl_attr_get_size(mask) call that triggers MSAN.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records set_post_parse.maskbuf_size == mask_size_call.maskbuf_size == 0.
